about: The version criterion of each release task ran python3 tools/interdeps.py --versions X against the working tree, so it held only while that release was the checked-out version: the 1.5.0 bump made the claimed XC-30 (Release 1.4.0) fail AC01 on the release branch, and XC-31 would fail the same way at 1.6.0. Each AC01 now reads the version strings from the tree of its own release tag (--at vX, added to tools/interdeps.py with tests), which is the artefact the task describes. The check is the same eleven version strings; only where they are read from changes. It becomes binding only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub.

changes.from: Every version string is 1.4.0 and the MCP package depends on x402-conformance-svm ^1.4.0
changes.to: Every version string is 1.4.0 in the tree of tag v1.4.0 and the MCP package depends on x402-conformance-svm ^1.4.0
